name: Akshaj
reason: akṣaja means diamond/thunderbolt and is an epithet of Vishnu; 'born of the eye' is not supported

fix.name: Akshaj
fix.meaning_en: Diamond; thunderbolt; an epithet of Vishnu.

name: Avik
reason: avika is attested as diamond (also sheep); 'brave' is a modern gloss without clear basis

fix.name: Avik
fix.meaning_en: Diamond; the popular gloss 'brave, fearless' is modern and its etymology uncertain.

name: Devang
reason: deva + aṅga, divine body; common boy's name

name: Eklavya
reason: iast should match the name as written (Eklavya, not Ekalavya); meaning should describe the name

fix.name: Eklavya
fix.meaning_en: Name of the devoted archer-pupil of the Mahabharata; etymology uncertain.

name: Gaurish
reason: gaurī + īśa, lord of Gauri (Shiva); correct sandhi

name: Mrinank
reason: spelling Mrinank does not match मृगांक; standard form is Mrigank

name: Nirmay
reason: nir + maya is not a standard Sanskrit word; meaning is a modern gloss

name: Revant
reason: Revanta, son of Surya, lord of horses
